title: Mrtr
excerpt: Context A proposal for implementing Multi Round Trip Requests (MRTR) as defined in SEP 2322. In the new protocol version servers can't initiate requests to clients, but when a server requires additional input for completing tools/call, prompts/get, or resources/read it can return an incomplete result along with a set of inputRequests.
